-- // Say Cheese Script

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Save = SaveModule and require(SaveModule) or nil

    warn("Remote Event 'Unlock' not found!")
    return

-- Hapus GUI lama jika ada

    CoreGui.EntropyEndingsGui:Destroy()
end

-- Buat ScreenGui di CoreGui

screenGui.Name = "EntropyEndingsGui"
screenGui.Parent = CoreGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 480)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
mainFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = false
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

Instance.new("UICorner", mainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
uiStroke.Thickness = 2
uiStroke.Parent = mainFrame

-- Auto-Scale Responsive agar pas di berbagai perangkat
local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
uiScale.Parent = mainFrame

local function updateAutoScaling()
    local screenSize = camera.ViewportSize
    local scale = math.clamp(screenSize.X / 1200, 0.8, 1.2)
    uiScale.Scale = scale
end

updateAutoScaling()
camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateAutoScaling)

-- Top Bar (Judul & Tombol Minimize/Maximize)
local topBar = Instance.new("Frame")
topBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
topBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
topBar.Parent = mainFrame

-- Sistem Drag Manual yang Mulus, Responsif, dan Bebas (Tanpa Pembatas Kaku)
local dragging, dragStart, startPos

topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.AbsolutePosition
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        local absSize = mainFrame.AbsoluteSize
        
        -- Perhitungan posisi bebas tanpa batas layar agar tidak ngebug/getar
        local newX = startPos.X + delta.X
        local newY = startPos.Y + delta.Y
        
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
            0, newX + (absSize.X * mainFrame.AnchorPoint.X), 
            0, newY + (absSize.Y * mainFrame.AnchorPoint.Y)
        )
    end
end)

scrollFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
scrollFrame.Parent = mainFrame

Instance.new("UICorner", scrollFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local uiListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

uiListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
uiListLayout.Parent = scrollFrame

local uiPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")

-- Footer (Note, Kredit, & Tombol Discord)
local footerFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

creditLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

creditLabel.TextSize = 12

creditLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
creditLabel.Parent = footerFrame

local discordLabel = Instance.new("TextButton")

discordLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 56)

discordLabel.Parent = footerFrame

Instance.new("UICorner", discordLabel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local isMinimized = false

toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isMinimized = not isMinimized
    if isMinimized then
        toggleBtn.Text = "+"
        scrollFrame.Visible = false
        footerFrame.Visible = false
        titleLabel.Text = "📸Say Cheese Unlock Endings"
        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 50)
    else
        toggleBtn.Text = "-"
        scrollFrame.Visible = true
        footerFrame.Visible = true
        titleLabel.Text = "📸Say Cheese Unlock Endings"
        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 480)
    end
end)

-- Fungsi Pembuatan Tombol Ending
local function createButton(endingName, endingId)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.Parent = scrollFrame
    
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    
    local alreadyUnlocked = false
    if Save and Save.has then
        alreadyUnlocked = Save.has(endingId)
    end
    
    if alreadyUnlocked then
        btn.Text = "Done " .. endingName
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    else
        btn.Text = "Unlock: " .. endingName
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        pcall(function()
            unlockEvent:FireServer(endingId)
        end)
        btn.Text = "Done " .. endingName
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
    end)
end

    isRejoinHolding = true
    noteLabel.Text = "Rejoining..."
    rejoinThread = task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(rejoinHoldTime)

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Terrain = workspace.Terrain
local UserGameSettings = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")

local saved = {
    effects = {},
    materials = {},
    textures = {}
}

local function restoreEffects()
    for obj, state in pairs(saved.effects) do
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                obj.Enabled = state
            end)
        end
    end
    table.clear(saved.effects)
end

-- ANTI LAG
AntiTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Anti Lag",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(value)
        if value then
            for _, obj in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                or obj:IsA("Trail")
                or obj:IsA("Beam")
                or obj:IsA("Fire")
                or obj:IsA("Smoke")
                or obj:IsA("Sparkles")
                or obj:IsA("PostEffect") then

                    saved.effects[obj] = obj.Enabled

                    pcall(function()
                        obj.Enabled = false
                    end)
                end
            end
        else
            restoreEffects()
        end
    end
})

-- LOW GRAPHICS
AntiTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Low Graphics",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(value)
        if value then
            table.clear(saved.materials)

            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    saved.materials[obj] = {
                        obj.Material,
                        obj.Reflectance
                    }

                    pcall(function()
                        obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                        obj.Reflectance = 0
                    end)
                end
            end
        else
            for obj, state in pairs(saved.materials) do
                if obj and obj.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        obj.Material = state[1]
                        obj.Reflectance = state[2]
                    end)
                end
            end

            table.clear(saved.materials)
        end
    end
})

            saved.shadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows

        elseif saved.shadows ~= nil then
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = saved.shadows
        end
    end
})

-- REMOVE TEXTURES
AntiTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Remove Textures",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(value)
        if value then
            table.clear(saved.textures)

            for _, obj in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do

                    end)
                end
            end
        else
            for obj, state in pairs(saved.textures) do
                if obj and obj.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        obj.Transparency = state
                    end)
                end
            end

            table.clear(saved.textures)
        end
    end
})

-- OPTIMIZE WATER

    Name = "Optimize Water",
    CurrentValue = false,

            saved.water = {
                Terrain.WaterWaveSize,

            Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0

            Terrain.WaterWaveSize = saved.water[1]
            Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = saved.water[2]
            Terrain.WaterReflectance = saved.water[3]

})

                    obj.Material = state[1]

            Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = saved.water[2]
            Terrain.WaterReflectance = saved.water[3]

        end

        if saved.decoration ~= nil then
            Terrain.Decoration = saved.decoration

        if saved.diffuse ~= nil then

            Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = saved.specular

            saved.specular = nil
        end

        if saved.quality then

                UserGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel = saved.quality
            end)
            saved.quality = nil
        end
    end
})
